name: Quality

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  frontend:
    name: Frontend quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@0ebf47130e4866e96fce0953f49152a61190b271 # v6.0.9
        with:
          version: 11.10.0
          run_install: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Check version consistency
        run: pnpm version:check

      - name: Lint frontend and scripts
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Check TypeScript project references
        run: pnpm type-check

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        run: pnpm audit --prod

      - name: Build frontend
        run: pnpm build

  rust:
    name: Rust quality (${{ matrix.name }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.timeout_minutes }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: macOS
            os: macos-14
            timeout_minutes: 45
          - name: Windows
            os: windows-2022
            # A cold Windows cache must compile many native dependencies. Allow enough time for runner variance.
            # This timeout only stops stalled jobs and does not delay builds that finish normally.
            timeout_minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Install pinned Rust toolchain
        run: rustup show

      - name: Cache Rust build artifacts
        # Cache Cargo dependencies and target artifacts per platform so every run does not rebuild from scratch.
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@c19371144df3bb44fab255c43d04cbc2ab54d1c4 # v2.9.1

      - name: Check formatting
        if: matrix.name == 'macOS'
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Check Rust workspace
        run: cargo check --workspace --locked

      - name: Lint Rust workspace
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings

      - name: Run Rust tests (macOS)
        if: matrix.name == 'macOS'
        run: cargo test --workspace --locked

      - name: Run Rust tests (Windows)
        if: matrix.name == 'Windows'
        # The dedicated Cargo configuration embeds the Common Controls v6 dependency into x64 Windows test
        # executables so every library test, including Tauri plugins, can resolve TaskDialogIndirect at startup.
        # Limit this job to library targets because manual audio examples require physical devices.
        run: cargo --config .cargo/windows-tests.toml test --workspace --locked --lib

      - name: Check generated TypeScript bindings
        if: matrix.name == 'macOS'
        run: git diff --exit-code -- 'src-tauri/plugins/*/js/bindings.gen.ts'

  rust-dependency-policy:
    name: Rust dependency policy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0

      - name: Check advisories, licenses, and sources
        # Pin cargo-deny-action v2.0.18 by commit so a mutable third-party tag cannot change CI behavior.
        uses: EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action@6c8f9facfa5047ec02d8485b6bf52b587b7777d1 # v2.0.18
        with:
          command: check advisories licenses sources
          arguments: ''
          rust-version: '1.88.0'

{
  "name": "flashvoice",
  "private": true,
  "version": "1.4.5",
  "description": "Local-first voice dictation with on-device speech recognition and optional AI proofreading.",
  "author": {
    "name": "harry0703",
    "email": "harry0703@hotmail.com",
    "url": "https://github.com/harry0703"
  },
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "homepage": "https://flashvoices.com",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/harry0703/FlashVoice.git"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/harry0703/FlashVoice/issues"
  },
  "type": "module",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22 <23",
    "pnpm": ">=11.10.0 <12"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "pnpm vite:dev",
    "dev:tauri": "tauri dev",
    "dev:debug": "cross-env RUST_BACKTRACE=1 tauri dev",
    "vite:dev": "cross-env DEBUG=0 vite",
    "preview": "vite preview",
    "test": "vitest run && node --test tests/node/*.test.js",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "build": "vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build",
    "type-check": "vue-tsc --build --force",
    "tauri": "tauri",
    "build:tauri": "tauri build",
    "build:release": "tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json",
    "build:win": "tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc",
    "build:mac": "tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json --target universal-apple-darwin",
    "rust:fmt": "cargo fmt --all",
    "rust:fmt:check": "cargo fmt --all -- --check",
    "rust:clippy": "cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings",
    "rust:clippy:fix": "cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked --fix --allow-dirty -- -D warnings",
    "rust:test": "cargo test --workspace --locked",
    "rust:check": "cargo check --workspace --locked",
    "rust:quality": "pnpm rust:fmt:check && pnpm rust:clippy && pnpm rust:check && pnpm rust:test",
    "rust:fix": "pnpm rust:fmt && pnpm rust:clippy:fix",
    "bindings:gen": "node scripts/gen-bindings.cjs",
    "bindings:gen:listener": "cd src-tauri/plugins/listener && cargo test export_types",
    "bindings:gen:misc": "cd src-tauri/plugins/misc && cargo test export_types",
    "bindings:gen:keyhook": "cd src-tauri/plugins/keyhook && cargo test export_types",
    "bindings:gen:textinject": "cd src-tauri/plugins/textinject && cargo test export_types",
    "bindings:gen:windows": "cd src-tauri/plugins/windows && cargo test export_types",
    "bindings:gen:transcriber": "cd src-tauri/plugins/transcriber && cargo test export_types",
    "bindings:gen:trayv2": "cd src-tauri/plugins/trayv2 && cargo test export_types",
    "clean:plugin:keyhook": "cargo clean -p tauri-plugin-keyhook",
    "format": "prettier --write .",
    "lint": "eslint --cache .",
    "lint:fix": "eslint --cache --fix .",
    "bump": "node scripts/bump-version.js",
    "version:check": "node scripts/bump-version.js --check",
    "info": "rustc --version && rustup show && pnpm tauri info",
    "check": "pnpm version:check && pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm build && pnpm rust:fmt:check && pnpm rust:check",
    "test:llm": "pnpm vitest run tests/unit/llm-providers.test.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@ai-sdk/anthropic": "^3.0.97",
    "@ai-sdk/google": "^3.0.94",
    "@ai-sdk/openai": "^3.0.85",
    "@ai-sdk/openai-compatible": "^2.0.61",
    "@lucide/vue": "^1.24.0",
    "@tailwindcss/typography": "^0.5.20",
    "@tauri-apps/api": "^2.11.1",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-autostart": "^2.5.1",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-clipboard-manager": "^2.3.2",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-deep-link": "^2.4.9",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog": "^2.7.1",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-fs": "~2.5.1",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-global-shortcut": "^2.3.2",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-http": "^2.5.9",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-opener": "~2.5.4",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-os": "^2.3.2",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-process": "^2.3.1",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-updater": "~2.10.1",
    "@tauri-apps/plugin-window-state": "^2.4.1",
    "@vueuse/core": "^14.3.0",
    "ai": "6.0.225",
    "class-variance-authority": "^0.7.1",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "motion-v": "^1.10.3",
    "party-js": "^2.2.0",
    "pinia": "^3.0.4",
    "reka-ui": "^2.10.1",
    "tailwind-merge": "^3.6.0",
    "tw-animate-css": "^1.4.0",
    "uuid": "^13.0.2",
    "vue": "^3.5.39",
    "vue-sonner": "^2.0.9"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@pinia/testing": "^1.0.3",
    "@tailwindcss/vite": "^4.3.2",
    "@tauri-apps/cli": "^2.11.4",
    "@tsconfig/node22": "^22.0.5",
    "@types/lodash-es": "^4.17.12",
    "@types/node": "^22.20.1",
    "@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin": "^8.64.0",
    "@typescript-eslint/parser": "^8.64.0",
    "@vitejs/plugin-vue": "^6.0.7",
    "@vitest/eslint-plugin": "^1.6.23",
    "@vue/eslint-config-prettier": "^10.2.0",
    "@vue/eslint-config-typescript": "^14.9.0",
    "@vue/test-utils": "^2.4.11",
    "@vue/tsconfig": "^0.8.1",
    "cross-env": "^10.1.0",
    "eslint": "^9.39.5",
    "eslint-plugin-security": "^3.0.1",
    "eslint-plugin-vue": "^10.9.2",
    "lodash-es": "^4.18.1",
    "prettier": "^3.9.5",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.3.2",
    "tailwindcss-animate": "^1.0.7",
    "typescript": "^5.9.3",
    "unplugin-auto-import": "^20.3.0",
    "unplugin-vue-components": "^30.0.0",
    "vite": "^7.3.6",
    "vite-tsconfig-paths": "^5.1.4",
    "vitest": "^4.1.10",
    "vue-tsc": "^3.3.7"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.10.0"
}

[profile.dev]
codegen-units = 16
debug = true
incremental = true
opt-level = 0

[profile.dev.package."*"]
debug = false
opt-level = 3

[profile.release]
codegen-units = 4
incremental = true
lto = "thin"
opt-level = 3
panic = "abort"
strip = true

[profile.fast]
codegen-units = 16
debug = false
incremental = true
inherits = "release"
lto = false
opt-level = 1
strip = true

[workspace]
members = [
    "src-tauri",
    "src-tauri/crates/audio",
    "src-tauri/crates/stt-assets",
    "src-tauri/crates/tcc",
    "src-tauri/crates/tracing-config",
    "src-tauri/crates/utils",
    "src-tauri/plugins/keyhook",
    "src-tauri/plugins/listener",
    "src-tauri/plugins/misc",
    "src-tauri/plugins/permissions",
    "src-tauri/plugins/textinject",
    "src-tauri/plugins/transcriber",
    "src-tauri/plugins/trayv2",
    "src-tauri/plugins/windows",
]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.package]
authors = ["harry0703 <harry0703@hotmail.com>"]
edition = "2021"
homepage = "https://flashvoices.com"
license = "Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/harry0703/FlashVoice"
rust-version = "1.88.0"

[workspace.dependencies]
flashvoice-audio = {path = "src-tauri/crates/audio"}
flashvoice-stt-assets = {path = "src-tauri/crates/stt-assets"}
flashvoice-tracing-config = {path = "src-tauri/crates/tracing-config"}
flashvoice-utils = {path = "src-tauri/crates/utils"}

tauri = "2"
tauri-build = "2"
tauri-plugin = "2"
tauri-plugin-autostart = "2"
tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager = "2"
tauri-plugin-deep-link = "2"
tauri-plugin-dialog = "2"
tauri-plugin-fs = "2"
tauri-plugin-global-shortcut = "2"
tauri-plugin-http = "2"
tauri-plugin-opener = "2"
tauri-plugin-os = "2"
tauri-plugin-persisted-scope = {version = "2", features = ["protocol-asset"]}
tauri-plugin-prevent-default = {version = "2.1", features = ["unstable-windows"]}
tauri-plugin-process = "2"
tauri-plugin-single-instance = {version = "2", features = ["deep-link"]}
tauri-plugin-store = "2"
tauri-plugin-updater = "2"
tauri-plugin-window-state = "2"
# Pin Git dependencies to reviewed commits so moving upstream branches cannot change builds for the same lockfile.
tauri-nspanel = {git = "https://github.com/ahkohd/tauri-nspanel", rev = "18ffb9a201fbf6fedfaa382fd4b92315ea30ab1a"}

tauri-plugin-keyhook = {path = "src-tauri/plugins/keyhook"}
tauri-plugin-listener = {path = "src-tauri/plugins/listener"}
tauri-plugin-misc = {path = "src-tauri/plugins/misc"}
tauri-plugin-permissions = {path = "src-tauri/plugins/permissions"}
tauri-plugin-textinject = {path = "src-tauri/plugins/textinject"}
tauri-plugin-transcriber = {path = "src-tauri/plugins/transcriber"}
tauri-plugin-trayv2 = {path = "src-tauri/plugins/trayv2"}
tauri-plugin-windows = {path = "src-tauri/plugins/windows"}

anyhow = "1"
bytes = "1.10.1"
chrono = "0.4.41"
codes-iso-639 = "0.1.5"
dirs = "6.0.0"
futures-util = "0.3.31"
hound = "3.5.1"
indoc = "2"
lazy_static = "1.5.0"
regex = "1.11.1"
reqwest = "0.12"
schemars = "0.8.22"
serde = "1"
serde_bytes = "0.11.17"
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"
serial_test = "3"
statig = "0.3.0"
strum = "0.26"
sysinfo = {version = "0.33.1", features = ["apple-app-store"]}
thiserror = "2"
tokio = "1"
tokio-stream = "0.1.17"
tracing = "0.1.41"

tracing-subscriber = "0.3.19"
url = "2"
uuid = "1"

specta = "2.0.0-rc.22"

cidre = {git = "https://github.com/yury/cidre", rev = "c5b0022"}
cpal = "0.15.3"

rust-version.workspace = true
